name: Cath
message:
Hi Stal,

Happy Supervisor Appreciation Week to my literal Wonder Woman! 💜

Handling a growing team of nearly 30 people is no joke. Behind that number are different personalities, concerns, emotions, and needs and so often, ikaw ang unang sumasalo. Ang dami mong pinapakinggan, inaasikaso, at dinadala, yet you continue to show up for our people every single time.

Ikaw ang pinakamalakas tumawa, ang pinakamadaling marinig sa crowd but I also know that sometimes, ikaw rin ang may pinakamabigat na dala. And I hope you know that I see you beyond the energy and the laughter. Nakikita ko rin ’yung effort at malasakit mo, even on days when showing up takes more out of you.

Honestly, I couldn’t imagine leading the Elsevier team without a “Stal.” Without you. You’ve made the difficult days bearable for me. Ang laking bagay na alam kong may kasama ako; someone who cares deeply about our people and whom I can count on as we figure things out together. Thank you for being that person for me.

Pero sana tandaan mo rin: hindi dahil kaya mong sumalo, kailangan ikaw na lang palagi. You deserve the same care and support you so freely give. Puwede ka ring mapagod, huminga, at magpasalo. Nandito rin ako para sa’yo.

Thank you for your strength, your big heart, and the laughter you bring into even our busiest days. I’m so grateful it’s you I get to do this with, Stal. Sana nararamdaman mo kung gaano kita pinapahalagahan. 💜

Love,
Cath

name: Mariel
message:
Hi Stal,

Every single night, I pray that mahaba pa ang iyong life.You have a heart big enough for all 24 of us (and counting)! I hope you find our time together as a team meaningful and fulfilling. May we be a source of strength for you as you keep aiming for goals at work and beyond. Thank you for all that you are.

<3
Mariel

name: Pau
message:
Hi Stal,

Happy Supervisor’s Appreciation Week!

Super thankful ako na ikaw ang supervisor namin since this team started. You’re very supportive, understanding, and someone we can talk to comfortably. Kahit more than 24 people ang hinahandle mo, you still make time to listen and make us feel heard. It means a lot to know na pwede kaming lumapit sayo and be honest about what we’re going through.

I also admire how strong you are and how you continue to show up for the team with patience and care, even when things get challenging. Those qualities are a big reason why I never doubted coming back to the team. Thank you for listening, supporting, and making the team feel cared for. We appreciate you!

name: Jam
message:
hi kristalyn!!

happy supervisor appreciation week!!

thank you for continuing to listen to my rants and non-stop concerns wahaaha. i know sometimes wala kang choice but to be a sponge, but please know i can do the same for you if you ever need an extra ear sa iyong mga hinanaing (hinanaing????).

i also just want to say how much i appreciate you, not only for guiding us with work, but for always making time to explain, support, and help us get through challenges. your patience, leadership, and positivity make a huge difference, lalo na when things get busy or stressful.

wishing you non-stop happiness and joy inside and outside work! i’m really lucky to work with such energetic and optimistic human being like you. thank you for being you, mamsh!

love you always! <3
jam

name: Arken
message:
Hi Ms. Stal!

Happy Supervisor's Appreciation Week!

Thank you po for being a very supportive and understanding supervisor! Although I haven't been long sa team, ramdam ko po yung pagiging "mom" of the team niyo in the way you handle us! Deeply appreciate the effort of remembering lahat ng mga ganaps sa end namin and looking out for us whenever may issues as well!

Appreciate you!!

name: Grace
message:
Kumareng Stal 😂,

Happy Supervisor Appreciation Week!

Just want to say thank you for always being so supportive, patient, and understanding. Sobrang na-appreciate ko lahat ng guidance, encouragement, and trust mo sa amin. Thank you for making us feel comfortable to ask questions, learn from our mistakes, and grow without feeling pressured. Ang gaan lang din knowing na we have someone like you na always willing to listen and help whenever we need it.

We're really lucky and grateful to have you as our supervisor. Thank you for everything you do, even the little things na minsan hindi namin nasasabi how much we appreciate. Hope you know how much you're valued!

name: Robert
message:
Hi Stal,

Thank you sa pagbibigay ng iyong full support, not just on a team level, but on an individual level. We truly appreciate ang effort na binibigay mo para mapaganda at mapaayos ang pagwwork namin. Thank you sa pakikinig sa mga hinanakit namin and trying your best to address it and find a solution for it. The team would not be what it is today without your help, guidance, and leadership.

Wishing you the best both in work life and personal life!

name: Alan
message:
Hi Stal!

Happy Supervisor Appreciation Week! Pero dapat sa’yo, Happy Supervisor Appreciation Year, kasi we appreciate you 365 days a year (366 days kapag leap year), haha!

Pero seryoso, thank you for always supporting, listening to, and caring for all 50 of us :) Tama ba, 50 na tayo and more to come? Hahaha! I hope you still get to rest and enjoy each day, kahit ang dami na namin and ang daming ganap. I'm so grateful na ikaw ang aming Supervisor.

I wish you all the best, not just sa work, but syempre sa personal life din. You deserve all the blessings you have, and the abundant blessings that are still to come. :)

Stay awesome!

name: A teammate
message:
Para sa aming energetic na supervisor,

Thank you for all the little and big things that you do for us. I truly believe that all your efforts play a big part why we are able to do great things and become better at what we do.
Thank you for always showing up and staying strong for us. Pero alam ko namang tao ka rin, napapagod din, kasi kami nga napapagod din.

There are times when I randomly find myself wondering how you manage to handle everything despite having so much on your plate and so many things to look after. And every time that thought crosses my mind, I am reminded to pray and ask the Lord to always guide you and protect your physical and mental health.

Stal remember that you have a lot of people here who are more than willing to listen whenever you feel tired, overwhelmed, or need someone to lean on. You don't always have to be the strong one.

You deserve all the good things life has to offer. :)

name: MJ
message:
Hi Stal,

Happy Supervisor Appreciation Week! :)

Thank you for being one of the best supervisor that I had worked with. I just want to highlight kung gaano mo pinapalighten up yung working environment especially during RTO. You are always approachable and you always make us feel that you really care for our career growth and mental health. One of the things that I appreaciate is your being genuine and true leader to the team. You always support us and make us feel that you always had our back especially when there are challenges at work. You are also one of the reasons, why I recommend this company to my previous colleagues.

With that, I hope that other people will get the chance to work and grow with you. And please prioritize your health as well and take well deserved vacations! Thank you Stal, continue shining and mabuhay ka!!!! <3

name: King
message:
Hi Stal,

Happy Supervisor Appreciation Week!

Thank you for all the support and guidance not just for me, but for the whole team. Thank you for being so approachable and understanding. It makes a huge difference knowing I can come to you with any issue/concerns.
I wish you all the best in life and career! More travels to come HAHAHA! Cheers!

name: Ryan
message:

Walang hanggang pasasalamat sa biyayang dulot mo 'di lang sa ating grupo, kundi pati na din sa akin. Sana'y kung papaanong ikaw'y nakapagbibigay ng liwanag sa bawat daang aming tinatahak, sukdulan maging bunga din sana ito ng di mapapantayang ligaya at galak sa iyong puso. Hanggang sa muli nating paglalakbay kasama nila Jam, Froi, Via, at Kyle, ang iyong honeybabs. XD

Taas-noong sumasaludo sa iyong pamumuno,
Ryan A.

name: Demmy
message:
Hi Stal,

Happy birthday! EME :D Happy Supervisor Appreciation Week!

I just want to thank you for being such an energetic and supportive supervisor. In all my years as a corporate tita, you’re one of the most genuine and caring supervisors I’ve had the privilege of working with.

Managing a large team isn’t easy, but you do a wonderful job—and I know the whole team would agree. We really appreciate you! Salamat sa efforts na i-check in ang bawat isa kung kumusta kami sa work and sa aming personal life and for always trying to make our time together fun, sa office and sa kung saan man! I am grateful that you saw my potential, trusted me and accepted me to be part of the team. Keep shining and if ever you need to talk to someone, we're always here! Pop off (avisala na rin, sabi nga ni jhan)! <3

name: MC
message:
Hello Stal,

Happy supervisor appreciation week! since malapit narin ang thanksgiving, I want to say how grateful i am (i'm sure we all are) to have you as our sup.
juskwaaa sa bilang palang namin, at kung pano mo kami arugain, hindi ko alam pano mo kami pinagkasyang lahat sa palad at puso mo 😂

name: JM
message:
Hi, Stal!

Happy Supervisor Appreciation Week!

I’ve always seen you as a strong woman, not just in your role as a leader, but in life in general. I really admire your sincere leadership and the way you’re able to touch so many people’s not just in our team. Advantage na rin siguro ng pagiging extrovert mo. LOL!

I know 2026 got off to a rough start for you, and maybe there were moments when you questioned what was happening or searched for answers. But I believe everything happens for a reason. In time, you’ll receive the blessings God has been preparing for you. You deserve to be happy! I appreciate you not only as a leader who supports us almost 24/7, but also as a friend I can trust. Someone who listens, understands, and acknowledges our personal struggles.

Chika ko lang! Ikaw ang unang nakaalam ng biggest blessing ko this year, after my immediate family. Even my closest cousins didn’t know until it happened. That says a lot about how much I trust you.

I pray that God blesses you with good health, more patience, more blessings, and of course, that one thing you’ve always been praying for!

Mahal ka namin, kapatid!
